summary.business_type: Developer tool / free web application (SaaS-like utility, no pricing, 26 locales)
summary.score_basis: Live site before the fixes in this commit set; lab data only (no CrUX, GSC or GA4 credentials).
top_findings: Escaping claim was false: JS/Python/PHP/Raw output emitted O'Brien unescaped and 007 / 0x1F / Infinity as bare numbers
Non-www host (https://arrayhelper.com/) and /index.html served 200 duplicates instead of 301
No security headers (HSTS, nosniff, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy)
JSON-LD used deprecated HowTo and invalid properties (codeRepository, availableLanguage on WebApplication)
Mobile first screen was a 720px empty editor; results and toolbar below the fold
quick_wins: Escape quotes/backslashes and use JSON number grammar in converter.js
Clean up JSON-LD graph in build.mjs
Real per-locale sitemap lastmod from git history

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Static server-rendered HTML per locale, identical for Googlebot/GPTBot/ClaudeBot
hreflang perfect on all 26 pages (27 alternates, self-reference, return tags, x-default, zh-Hans)
Canonicals correct on every variant, http->https 301, Brotli, HTTP/2 + HTTP/3, real 404 status

findings.title: Apex host serves a 200 duplicate
findings.description: https://arrayhelper.com/ returned 200 (canonical to www) instead of 301.

findings.title: No security headers
findings.description: No HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Add in src/.htaccess mod_headers block (done; CSP left for later because of inline gtag + jsDelivr Monaco).

findings.title: /index.html duplicates return 200
findings.description: /index.html and /<code>/index.html are reachable copies.

findings.title: robots.txt / sitemap.xml cached 30 days
findings.description: ExpiresDefault 1 month applied to text/plain and XML.

findings.title: Server-default 404 page
findings.description: No way back to the site from a 404.

findings.title: og:image dimensions wrong
findings.description: Declared 1200x630, file is 2121x1114.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: ~1,170 unique words on the English page, Flesch 68, no filler phrases
All 25 translations structurally complete; specific first-hand details

findings.title: Escaping claim false for Raw/JS/Python/PHP
findings.description: O'Brien produced ['O'Brien'] (syntax error) despite features/FAQ promising per-language escaping.

findings.title: Strictly-valid JSON claim false for exotic numbers
findings.description: 007, +5, .5, 0x1F, Infinity emitted unquoted.

findings.title: No visible author/about/privacy information
findings.description: E-E-A-T 51/100: no byline, no dates, no about or privacy disclosure while GA and jsDelivr load.
findings.recommendation: Add an #about block (who built it, contact, analytics/CDN disclosure) to page.html + 26 locale files. Open.

findings.title: Dedupe label reads as a noun in 21 locales
findings.description: e.g. de 'Duplikate' reads as 'enable duplicates'.
findings.recommendation: Verb phrase per locale ('Duplikate entfernen'). Open.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Keyword-led title (59 chars) and description (158 chars), one H1, valid heading order

findings.title: Brand spelled three ways
findings.description: ArrayHelper / Array Helper / arrayHelper; brand collides with Yii/Craft/CodeIgniter ArrayHelper classes.
findings.recommendation: meta.appName unified to 'ArrayHelper – ...' in 26 locales and alternateName added in schema (done).

findings.title: Output textareas had junk accessible names
findings.description: aria-label='rawOutput-label' etc., untranslated.

findings.title: da and no share an identical title
findings.description: src/i18n/da.json and no.json meta.title are identical.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: One valid @graph per page, 0 dangling @id, truthful free Offer, FAQ mirrors visible text

findings.title: Deprecated HowTo node on all 26 pages
findings.description: No rich result since Sep 2023; tool typed incorrectly.

findings.title: Invalid properties on WebApplication
findings.description: codeRepository and availableLanguage are outside the type's domain.

findings.title: Logo pointed at the 2121x1114 OG card

findings.title: FAQPage kept
findings.description: FAQ rich results retired 2026-05-07; harmless, no removal.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)

findings.title: GA4 loaded on first interaction caused 240 ms keydown
findings.description: gtag evaluation landed inside the first typing burst.
